    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = r.concept_id

)
SELECT r.disease, r.shared_genes,
       COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_occurrences,
       COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS diagnosed_patients,
       MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_date,
       MAX(co.condition_start_date) AS last_date
FROM related r
JOIN descendants d ON d.disease = r.disease
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.condition_concept_id = d.concept_id
GROUP BY r.disease, r.shared_genes
ORDER BY diagnosed_patients DESC, diagnosis_occurrences DESC

Using MedCP, I interpreted “biologically related” as diseases sharing MS-associated genes in the knowledge graph, then counted local OMOP condition diagnoses mapped through descendant condition concepts.

Top biologically related diseases diagnosed here, by distinct patients:

| Rank | Disease | Shared MS genes | Diagnosed patients | Diagnosis occurrences |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Hypertension | 32 | 458,168 | 5,986,000 |
| 2 | Anemia | 29 | 307,677 | 3,433,720 |
| 3 | Arthritis | 35 | 261,856 | 3,263,831 |
| 4 | Asthma | 44 | 232,258 | 1,863,803 |
| 5 | Diabetes mellitus | 35 | 207,331 | 4,829,096 |
| 6 | Liver disease | 37 | 197,214 | 4,531,576 |
| 7 | Hypothyroidism | 38 | 126,323 | 1,633,295 |
| 8 | Type 2 diabetes mellitus | 36 | 116,537 | 2,425,217 |
| 9 | Atopic dermatitis | 38 | 76,882 | 624,727 |
| 10 | Inflammatory bowel disease | 56 | 27,774 | 870,607 |

Other highly MS-related autoimmune diseases were less frequent locally: psoriasis 24,065 patients, rheumatoid arthritis 19,126, Crohn’s disease 13,853, systemic lupus erythematosus 10,809.

Caveat: broad diseases like hypertension/anemia are frequent because they are common in the EHR, not necessarily because they are the most specific biological neighbors of MS.
